claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetan craft combine holographic interfaces with physical joysticks and pedals; telepathic controls can materialize to fit each pilot, while Alfrateans may need manual or autopilot.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She describes Toleka’s layered harmonic shields as containing hangar air and allowing slow craft through while blocking fast projectiles via velocity and tuned-frequency effects.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygetan shields absorb kinetic and energy impacts, strengthening when struck; maximum protection requires plasma engines running and cannot be sustained continuously.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
